tree.heading: Motorboat Fuel Taxes.—
tree.text: There shall be set aside in the Fund the amounts specified in section 9503(c)(3)(B) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 (26 U.S.C. 9503(c)(3)(B)).

tree.heading: Refunds of Taxes.—
tree.text: There shall be paid from time to time from the Fund into the general fund of the Treasury amounts estimated by the Secretary of the Treasury as equivalent to—

children.text: the amounts paid before October 1, 2029, under section 6421 of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 (26 U.S.C. 6421) with respect to gasoline used after December 31, 1964, in motorboats, on the basis of claims filed for periods ending before October 1, 2028; and

80 percent of the floor stocks refunds made before October 1, 2029, under section 6412(a)(1) of the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 (26 U.S.C. 6412(a)(1)) with respect to gasoline to be used in motorboats.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2021—Subsec. (b). Pub. L. 117–58 substituted “October 1, 2029” for “October 1, 2023” in pars. (1) and (2) and “October 1, 2028” for “October 1, 2022” in par. (1). 2015—Subsec. (b)(1). Pub. L. 114–94 substituted “October 1, 2023” for “October 1, 2017” and “October 1, 2022” for “October 1, 2016”. Subsec. (b)(2). Pub. L. 114–94, § 31102(e)(2)(B)(i), substituted “October 1, 2023” for “October 1, 2017”.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 2021 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 117–58 effective Oct. 1, 2021, see section 80102(f) of Pub. L. 117–58, set out as a note under section 4041 of Title 26, Internal Revenue Code.

notes.heading: Effective Date of 2015 Amendment
notes.text: Amendment by Pub. L. 114–94 effective Oct. 1, 2016, see section 31102(f) of Pub. L. 114–94, set out as a note under section 4041 of Title 26, Internal Revenue Code.
